items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: They were all royal names. Earl Hines and so forth, you know?

ctx.x: Well, he was with you with Kirby, wasn't he?
No. Bill Beason was working with Kirby, and Walter Fuller [SIC: He means Wallace Bishop, who also had played with Earl Hines], he was with Kirby. That's all the drummers he had when I was there.
